violations.why: ISR sets v_onyx to 50 between the loop init write and the loop condition read, so the condition sees 50 instead of 0.
ISR changes v_onyx after the bounds check and before it is used as the index, so the checked value differs from the one used.
ISR overwrites v_onyx between the index use and the increment read, so the increment starts from 50.
Non-atomic v_onyx++ read-modify-write is interrupted, so the ISR's write is overwritten by the stale increment.
ISR overwrites the incremented value before the loop condition reads it.
ISR write occurs between the index read and the increment write, and the increment overwrites the ISR value.
